segments.text: in the country we are implementing the philippine geothermal de-risking facility to revive geothermal

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: exploration in the philippines we are also conducting additional green energy auctions such

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: as waste-to-energy, offshore wind, agro-solar, solar on stilts, solar on irrigation canals,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: and off-grid areas. Nuclear energy remains part of the DOE's long-term energy strategy,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: functioning as cheaper and more reliable baseload power. The mid-merit natural gas capacity auction

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: is targeted to be completed by December of 2026. We also have major plans and programs

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: to ensure energy security, including the deployment of MES, establishment of a state-owned

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: strategic petroleum reserve, permutation of the Visayas, Mindoro, and Palawan energy master

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: plants, implementation of policies for generation companies' accountability, review of systems loss

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: related policies and programs, push for government-wide adoption of electric vehicles or EVs,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: and deployment of EV charging stations. We also have several key projects to strengthen

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: governance, including the full digitalization, automation, and AI transformation of DOE,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: the establishment of the Center for Energy Excellence, comprising of the Energy Museum,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: Energy Academy, and the R&D Center, the strengthening of DOE manpower, the modernization

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: nationwide command center, and the upgrading of DOE facilities to achieve net-zero energy consumption.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the honorable members of the committee, this ends my presentation.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: Thank you for your kind attention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Thank you, Yusek. Thank you very much. Next to present, Chairman Francis Wan. You have the floor, sir.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairperson and the honorable members of the committee.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Good morning. I am Francis Attenino C. Wan, the chairperson and CEO of the Energy Regulatory

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Commission, and thank you for this opportunity to present our budget for 2027.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: The ERC is an independent quasi-judicial body created under the IPERA.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And with me in the commission are four other commissioners, Commissioner Florescinda Digal, Marco Fuentes, Amante Liberato, and Paris Real.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Our mandate is to promote market competition, ensure consumer choice, protect consumer interests, keep retail rates based on prudent and reasonable cost recovery, and penalize abuse of market power.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We regulate and oversee the full electricity value chain, the regulated sectors, namely the transmission and the distribution sectors, as well as the competitive sectors, the generation and supply.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And at the center of everything we do are the consumers, upholding the rights and interests of our consumers, both captive and contestable.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: The slide four is on the...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: In the sector that we regulate, it is currently valued at around 4.19 trillion.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And this is just to emphasize the scale of the sector that our proposed budget of 944 million must support.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For ERC accomplishments, we have issued so far for a period from January 2025 until June 2026,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have imposed 157 millions in fines.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have directed the refund of around 71.3 billion.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: P70 billion of that came from Meralco's filing of its actual weighted average tariff for the lapsed years during the time when its rates were not reset by the earlier commission.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have approved 292 power supply agreements.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: These are the agreements between distribution utilities and generation companies for the supply of electricity.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And 184 of that with the final authority.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Comparing that to the performance of ERC during the entire 2024, we have approved in 2024 only two power supply agreement applications and five CAPEX applications.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For the lifeline rate program in...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: response to the call of the president to expand the scope and coverage of the lifeline program under IPIRA as extended by law.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have actually launched a national lifeline program, expanded its coverage to up to 50 kilowatt hours for the marginalized end users.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And right now, we are able to cater to around 620,000 qualified marginalized end users.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Net metering also, in response to the call of the president, net metering registrations are up 51.77%.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And so far as the implementation of retail competition or ARCOA, with even the lowering of the threshold...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: to 100 kilowatt, where those with demand of 100 kilowatt can now choose their own supplier, we've seen and estimated that the cost savings to these customers that opted to avail of their choice and contracted with retailers, the estimated cost savings to them already amounted to 19.87 billion.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: decisions that we have issued, aside from the lowering of the contestable threshold to 100 kilowatt, we have issued the first ever transmission wheeling rules for the off-grid.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: This is the first time that we would have a regulatory framework for the transmission service to be provided in the off-grid areas, starting with Mindoro and Palawan as soon as this is established.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: restarted the rate reset of our private distribution utilities and directed the private distribution utilities to respectively file their actual weighted average tariff filings.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And we have also addressed thousands of CAPEX filings and point-to-point transmission proposals.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have disposed of thousands of them.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And we have supported the push for renewable energy by performing our part in the J-UP program of the Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have set the reserve price for the off-grid.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For the offshore wind, we have also...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: set the reserve price for the Pioneer Waste to Energy Projects.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have established for the first time the Green Energy Auction Allowance to be able to support the new capacities that are being built under the J-UP program of the Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have also updated our rules on the advanced metering infrastructure...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: so that we can finally modernize our grid.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have addressed long-standing issues in the generation sector, such as the public offering requirement,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have updated the fit allowance.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have updated the UCME as well as the SAGAR in some of the off-grid areas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And every one of these, among others, was delivered within...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And for 2027, our priorities remain to have fair and evidence-based rate setting, timely resolution of pending cases, robust oversight to foster competition, and a stable and enhanced regulatory environment to attract investment in our sector.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And all these are anchored in proactive consumer finance.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For our thrust on fair and evidence-based rate setting, aside from setting the gear prices for our J-UP, we have already issued the draft rules governing the regulatory framework for our gas auction.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We will soon be finalizing that.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: enforce more strictly the distribution utilities' least-cost supply obligations under our revised 2026 CSP guidelines.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And soon, the guidelines that we will issue on the review of the terms of reference to be used by our distribution utilities that will be conducting their CSPs.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And that will also include our target of conducting more timely...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: audits of the de-use implementation of their pass-through charges.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We will also complete the reset of the rates of the distribution utilities, both the private distribution utilities and the electric cooperatives.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: This has not been done in more than 10 years.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: There has been no new rates approved for our distribution utilities.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have already approved the final determination for the rate reset of one of our private distribution utilities belonging to the Group A under the performance-based regulation.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And all the other distribution utilities in Group A will follow suit.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We are targeting to complete the rate reset of Group B within the year and for Group C and D for the private distribution utilities.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So this is something that was not done in more than a decade.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And we are targeting to finish the rate reset of the private distribution utilities in 2027.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Also, the new rates of our electric cooperatives, we target that they would have already their new rates to be implemented starting January.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Again, this is something that has not been done.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: The last rate setting for our electric cooperatives happened in early 2010.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So after more than a decade, we will soon have their new rates.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And this is in time also for the push now for our distribution utilities to address their system losses.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And prepare them for the eventual removal of the system losses.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For the trust on consumer-focused leadership, we have just approved the revised Magna Carta for electricity consumers.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And we intend to conduct an extensive information and education campaign across the country to be able to educate and inform.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Our consumers as regards their rights under the Magna Carta.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For our budget, our budget for 2027.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Or over the years, our GAA grew modestly from 911.6 million in 2024 to 931 million in 2026.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We have proposed a budget of 1.7 billion to be able to cover all the plans and programs that we intend to implement for 2027.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Unfortunately, the NEP only reflects 944.065 million or 44.67% below what we proposed.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Concentrated mainly in the MOOE and capital outlay.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And in the MOOE included there is the budget for the consultancy services that we intended supposedly to assist us complete the rate reset of our private distribution utilities and electric cooperatives as well as NGCP for 2027.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Our overall utilization rate has climbed.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So that will show our absorptive capacity and our ability to responsibly manage a larger budget.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So from a low of 28.08% in 2021, it has risen to 46.81 in June of 2026.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So that covers the first semester of the year.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: On an annual basis, our full year utilization last year was already at 84.20% up from a low of 62%.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: In 2023, our revenues, we have consistently brought in more to the to the government in terms of the supervision fees, as well as the permit fees and fines that we collect.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: With a budget of 20 of 931 million, we were able to bring to the government a total of 2.354 billion in revenue or 121% above our, our projection.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And definitely way above the budget that was allocated for us in 2025.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: We expect that we will hit the same level for 2027 so bottom line is the ERC is a net revenue generator for the government and this budget request of 1.7 billion would have been offset by what we return to the treasury and unfortunately our NEP stands out.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: It stands only at 944 million. That will be the end of my presentation. Your honors, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Thank you, Chair. This is going to be a working lunch. Para lang malaman ng colleagues natin, we distributed a presentation of NEA, NAPOCOR, PNOC, PNOC-EC, PISAM, and TRANSCO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So nasa inyo na po yung briefer po nila. Para po mas mabilis po tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But before I call on to the interpreter, I would like to recognize Congressman Salvador Plato, Vice Chair Bernadette Barberis, Vice Chair Maria Cristina Talavera Lopez, Deputy Minority Leader Presley Desus, Congressman John Chan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Congressman Julio Cesar Vergara, Congressman Steve Solon, Congressman Dibutuan, Congressman Ernel Ceniza, Congressman Munir Arbizon, Congressman Joseph Yu, Vice Chair Isabela Zagadbaria, Representative Catherine Guraceta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The interpellation may remind our distinguished colleagues that each member is allotted five minutes for questions or interpellation, excluding the response of the resource person.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: When the bell sounds, the members have 30 minutes to conclude or wind up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Consistent with the longstanding practice of the House, the Chair shall recognize minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Independent and majority members in an alternating manner when practicable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The Chair first recognizes the Honorable Percy Zendanya from the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Pag-uswang Percy, you have the floor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair. Magandang umaga po sa DOE family led by Secretary Sharon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: karami-rami na po tayo ng mga hinarap ng mga budget briefings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At kadalasan po, yung mga budget briefings na ito ay mga grievance mechanisms

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: para po sa mga departamento na nakaranas ng matinding mga pagbabas sa kanilang budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At siguro po, in so many days, this is the first time na wala akong gano'ng narinig

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: na grievance from our colleagues from the executive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Napansin ko rin po na across all areas, from PS, MOOE hanggang CO,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: ay may increase po tayo with an overall increase of more than a little over 25%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Secretary Green, why is this the case po for DOE kaya?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: I think, Mr. Chair, I think because the increases are focused on three things.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It's the gradiometry, mobile energy system, and the automation.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Kasi wala tayong data on what we have as resources here in the Philippines

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: on oil and gas and other matters.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, this should have been done 10, 20 years back.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: That's why we don't have any new exploration.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We only have malampaya until today.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, with that new data, investors will see what we have.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We cannot sell something that we don't know what's in it.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, that's why we need the gradiometry study.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It will take about 2 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, another budget was allotted for 2027, sir.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Now, the MES is a mobile energy system na parang siyang container.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Tapos may mga solar panels with battery and maybe turbina ng for diesel or whatever technology there is.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: That will address that whenever there's an emergency,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: we can deploy these units to, for example,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: the usual path would be like Masbate, Bicol area, and up to the north.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, we'll deploy it strategically in some parts also, in some islands na wala talagang connection.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We can put it there like what we did in Kalayaan.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: The third one, sir, is the ISSP.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Every year and every month, actually, but the system is still manual.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, for us to have a more data-driven data analysis also of what we need as policies,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: we need it to be automated so we can move faster and be more transparent.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, this is to automate from front to back end, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, those are the three that contributed to the 25% increase, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kaya ako po tinanong, kasi mapapasana all po pala tayo when we listen to the budget of the DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sana yung equally critical agencies natin, lalong-lalong yung social services,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: would also enjoy the same increase in their budget and not a significant cut as we have seen the past few days.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Secretary, for the very comprehensive explanation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Alam ko po, bahagi ito na isang malaking programa at isang malaking plano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero po para sa ating mga kababayan na nakikinig, given all this po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: bababa na po ba ang presyo ng kuryente?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, just before that, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: the 25% increase in comparison to the other agencies is 25% of 2.5 billion.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It's really very small compared to the other agencies.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Now, to lower the price of electricity, it's a very multifaceted issue.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We are, if we have, generally, yes, sir.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: If you ask me, yes, it will lower the price.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: If we have more oil and gas that are indigenous, yes, it will lower it.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: If we have more renewable, yes, it will lower it.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: If we have a good coordination between the policy and then the regulation,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: those are several, we need several things to make it lower and lower.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And all these policies, eventually, the intention of all the policies that DOE is doing now,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: the intention really is to lower the rates, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Secretary, for giving that assurance sa mga kababayan po nating nanonood.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At araw-araw po ay kinakabanting makakatanggap ng kanilang electric bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Alam na po siguro ng NEA na itatanong ko ang question na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sukin nyo na po ako taon-taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero nalulungkot po ako na sukin nyo ako taon-taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Last year po sa budget hearing natin, nabanggit po ng NEA Administrator, Nani Almeda,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: na i-rescind ng NEA ang Memorandum No. 2023-52.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero alam po natin na hindi ito na-rescind.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And in fact, suspended lamang po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang tanong ko po, bakit po hindi pa na-rescind ng NEA ang iligal na memorandum na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Tapos kanina po kasi, I was looking at the presentation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: ang dami pong mga linemen na mga electric co-ops,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: na siyang bayani natin para ma-restore ang electricity every time merong malaking sakuna sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero marami po sa kanila na pagkakaitan ng collective bargaining agreement

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: dahil po dito sa inyong iligal na memorandum na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ma, ano po nangyari, Admin Almeda?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: We have addressed the situation of the collective bargaining agreement issue.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Just for the information of the committee,

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: we have already sat down with the Secretary of Labor and the various groups

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: and we are coming up with a manualization of the Electric Cooperative Industry Tripartite Council.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Wherein DOLE, the National Mediation Board, NEA, and the labor groups

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: will work together in a technical working group committee

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: to come up with the guidelines of the rules that will govern the collective bargaining agreement.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: It's suspended for the simple reason that there are peculiarities in the electric cooperative industry.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: But we are trying to resolve everything through this tripartite council

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: as well as the due representation of the federation and the labor groups concerned.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: And hopefully, we can move forward.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: We have already convened two weeks ago.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Our next meeting will be on September 10.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: And once we are able to come up with a resolution through the tripartite council,

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: everything will be within the framework of the manualization, sir.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pasensya na po kayo sa impatience, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi marami po ang mga nakabimbi ng mga CBA ng ating mga unions,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: iba't iba mga power cooperatives po sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kung ito po ay sa Senado, sasabihin po sa akin nung kabilang side na asked and answered.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: This was the same question I raised last year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And more or less, this is the same answer that I'm getting this year.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Mr. Chair, just for the information, there were a lot of CBAs that were already resolved.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Medyo dun lang po talaga sa mga CBAs that will affect the very operations of the electric cooperatives.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: NEA has been trying to find a way.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: On how to give in to the demands in the CBA.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Will this illegal memorandum be rescinded?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Eventually, sir, if we will be able to come up with resolutions through the Tripartite Council,

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kawawa naman po yung ating mga manggagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sana po sa susunod na budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: hindi na po ito ating tanong kasi po na-rescind na ang Memorandum No. 2023-52.

segments.text: Ito po yung mga bayani natin sa power sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At bigyan po natin sila ng tamang pagkilala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At bayan po natin yung mga gagawa na tinitiyak na may kuryenteng dumadaloy sa bawat tahanan po sa mga lugar sa Pilipinas.

segments.text: And maraming salamat po sa DOE family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Next to interpolate from the majority, Congressman Celso Rehensha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: I would like to raise this concern on Iligan City regarding the rising electricity costs and supply stability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Iligan's electricity charge increased from 13 pesos and 60 centavos per kilowatt

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: hour in July 2026 to 15 pesos and 13 centavos per kilowatt hour in August this year also,

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: an increase of 1 peso and 52 centavos, or an 11.19 percent in just one month.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: At this level, Iligan is among the higher rates charged by major distribution utilities in the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: For comparison, Mr. Chair, reported rates are approximately

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: 14.96 pesos per kilowatt hour for BICO or Visayas Electric Cooperative and 14 pesos and 78 centavos for Meralco and 12.31 pesos for Cipalco.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: This is particularly concerning because Iligan, Mr. Chair, is the host of Agus 5, 6, and 7 with a combined dependable capacity of approximately 279 MW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: Mr. Chair, with this, I would like to address my concern to the PISAM through the help of the Honorable Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: The following points. Number one, Mr. Chair, what was the basis for reducing the firm allocation serving Iligan to 8.75 MW, where the city's actual demand, supply needs, and the possible impact on consumers considered? Number two, can the PISAM consider providing an additional 16.25 MW of firm power, bringing the allocation serving Iligan City back to 25 MW, if feasible as an interim measure while longer-term supply alternatives are being pursued? Those are the two concerns, Mr. Chair. PISAM?

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: Mr. Chair, regarding the first question on why there were reductions in our capacity allocations for certain cooperatives and distributed utilities, sir,

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: we implemented a program in 2026, re-evaluation.

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: We had to reduce the supply requirements because what we provide to our co-ops is based on the actual capacity of the power plants.

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: And due to the reductions in the dependable capacity of Agus and Pulangi, we also had to correspondingly reduce.

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: Our capacity allocations for co-ops to use, including illegal light and power.

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: As to the second question, sir, if it's possible to increase the capacity allocation to illegal light and power, sir,

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: as I committed to you earlier, sir, on our side meeting, sir, PISAM and our trading team will evaluate the request of illegal light

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: and we will try to increase the firm and if not non-firm allocation to illegal light and power, sir.

segments.speaker: PSALM President and CEO Dennis Edward de la Serna
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you very much, sir. And, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we understand, Mr. Chair, that the PISAM has limited capacity and must follow its policies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: We are not asking preferential treatment or special treatment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: We are asking for assistance for our consumers, given illegal role as host to major national power assets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: We respectfully seek a fair and practical solution that can provide greater supply,

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: stability, and more reasonable electricity costs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I also raise this because the issue may not be unique to Iligan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: How firm power is allocated with the local demand and consumer impact are considered.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: Could affect other districts as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: We hope that Iligan's case can also help guide a fair approach for similarly situated communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Celso G. Regencia
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. That's all.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At supposedly, kapagka nagkaroon naman ng pangungulekta ng line rental,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ito ay mapapasama doon sa bayarin ng mga distribution utilities na bumili mula sa WESEM.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero kung yung amount na malilikom mula sa lahat ng mga customers o yung tinatawag nating trading amount ng mga customers

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ay sosobra doon sa pangangailangan upang mabayaran.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yung trading amount naman, kabuoang trading amount ng para sa generators, magkakaroon ng surplus.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At nandoon sa mekanismo ng WESEM, kapagka may surplus, dapat ito ay ibabalik.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Doon sa mayroong kontribusyon dyan sa surplus na yan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Mari kong ipaliwanag lang po. Hopefully, maging mas simple.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang ating pong locational marginal prices sa bawat node, ito po ay binubuo ng system marginal price o ito yung palang base price.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At on top of the base price, ay mayroong cost.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Mayroong cost of line losses at saka yung cost of congestion.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kasi mayroon ng inherent din na losses even sa ating transmission lines.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya kung halimbawa ang isang customer, mangangailangan ng 100 megawatt, pero mayroong 2% na nawawala sa linya,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ang isang generator na magsusupply dito sa customer na ito, kakailanganin kung halimbawa 2%,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: kakailanganin na magsusupply hindi lang ng 100 megawatt, kailangan may sobra na 102 kung 2%.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dahil kung kailangan niya 100 at 100 lang ang isupply ng generator, ang mangyayari niyan, kulang.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya mayroong kailangan siyang 2 megawatt na additional na isusupply at yung 2 megawatt na yan, may kabayaran niyan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya ito ay nadadagdag doon sa locational marginal price.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ng node na ito, ito po ay yung isa pa lang na component, yung line loss.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pagdating naman sa congestion, kung ang isang node ay masusupplyan sana ng generator na nandito sa kabilang node,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: pero ang linya ay congested na, umabot na doon sa line limit na yan,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ibig sabihin kahit pa ito sana ang pinakamurang generator, para masupplyan yung pangangailangan ng customer na ito,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: kailangan ng mayroong isang generator pa na nakakonekta sa kabilang linya na mag-generate kung anong megawatt yung hindi maitawid dito sa linya na ito.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito naman po ang tinatawag na congestion cost.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ngayon po, kada node, iba-iba ang nagiging LMP.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Normally, maliit lang naman ang variance ng ating mga...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero ang napansin po namin, sa tuwing nagkakaroon ng binding constraint,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: kasi po, hindi naman lahat ng generation na kailangan ng Visayas ay nage-generate sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Mayroon po siyang kinukuha mula sa Mindanao at ito ay dumadaloy doon sa interconnection ng Visayas at Mindanao.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ngayon po, may limitasyon ang pwedeng tumawid ng megawatts doon.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya sa tuwing ang pangangailangan ng Visayas ay napakalaki at hindi na ito kayang maitawid doon sa 450 na yan,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ang yung ating market management system, yung MDOM na yan,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ang ginawa niya, naglalabas siya ng magkaibang SMP or system marginal price.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Iba ang system marginal price doon sa Mindanao, iba ang nagiging system marginal price sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kasi mas mababa yung marginal plant doon.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dito sa Visayas, mas mataas kasi nga, mas mahal yung planta, yung marginal plant na kakailanganin para masupply yung demand sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dahil nagkakaiba yung system marginal price, nagiging malaki ang difference ng kanilang LMP.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Remember, ang SMP kung isa lang yan across all the nodes, maliit lang ang variance dahil manggagaling lang yan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ngayong nagkaroon ng SMP na iba sa Mindanao, mas mababa at mas mataas doon sa SMP ng Visayas,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: yung mga distribution utilities natin, sila yung mga customers, halimbawa sila yung nakakonekta sa node sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung meron silang kontrata sa isang generation company na nasa Mindanao,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: karaniwan sana mababa yung makukuha nilang kontrata.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung meron silang kuryente, batay na rin doon sa kanilang kontrata with that generation company.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya lang, since hindi makapagpatawid ng kuryente yung galing Mindanao,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: yung pangangailangan ng distribution utility na yan sa Visayas ay manggagaling sa isang planta na mas mahal na manggagaling sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya, ang exposure niya nangyayari, meron siyang exposure sa WSM dahil in effect,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: meron siyang kuryente na yan sa Visayas at mas mahal ang LMP sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ngayon po, paano nagkakaroon ng spike sa line rental?

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Meron po kasing formularyo ang line rental at ito po ay nakadepende doon sa difference ng LMP ng seller o ng generator,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: yung nasa Mindanao, kasi kung ang generator ay nasa Mindanao, at yung LMP ng customer sa Visayas.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang ito po ay malaki, malaki rin po ang nakakalculate na line rental.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero, wala pong mali doon, wala pong overcharge doon.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang nangyayari lang po sa ating price determination methodology na umiiral sa WSM,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ang nakokolektang amount mula doon sa customer na nasa Visayas, dahil nakabasingado sa LMP niya sa Visayas,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang nakokolekta from the customers dito sa Visayas, mas malaki kaysa doon sa dapat sanang ibayad sa mga generator.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dahil ang kanila namang nodal price, yung LMP nila ay nasa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang pagbalansi sana yan, para mabawi nung na-expose sa mataas na line rental,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: kung magkakaroon ng mataas din na net settlement surplus, dapat ay ang distribution nito, ang allocation nito,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: yung formulari yung approved ng ERC, dapat ang allocation yan ay mas malaki doon sa mas malaki ang binayad dahil doon sa congestion.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang nakita po nating diferensya, dahil nga po yung market management system, yung makina,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ay naglabas ng presyo na malaki ang variance ng LMPs at nagkaroon ng dalawang SMP yung magkabila.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ipapasok ngayon itong data na ito, ipapasok po yan doon sa isang sistema pa na ginagamit ng ating market.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito naman yung tinatawag na CRSS, yung Central Registration Settlement System.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dito po, papasok sana yung datos na yun galing sa MMS at dito sa CRSS, kukomputin niya rin niya automatically yung lalabas na net settlement allocation.

Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: At sir, in layman's term, marami po kasing hindi, technically, hindi naiintindihan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Naglabas po kami ng order noong August 13, 2026.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Muna yung pangungulekta ng line rental.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung ano ang magiging shortfall doon sa trading amount ng mga generators, i-allocate siyang kolektahin mula doon sa mga customers.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Second, ang longer term solution is gumawa ng isang sistema, ang IMOP, ang market operator,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: nagsaganon kung ano yung datos na papasok sa CRSS.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito ay nakabatay na doon sa kung ano talaga dapat ang line loss at saka ang congestion cost.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Iisa lang yung naging SMP nila noong dalawang nodes para nagsaganon tama ang maging alokasyon.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito po ang gagawin ngayon ng IMOP at yung mga nakaraang panahon na nagkaroon ng tingin namin ng hindi patas na pagbabalik noong net settlement surplus allocation.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito po ay pinag-utos namin sa IMOP na ipa-audit sa isang third party.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Nagsaganon makita natin yung extent kung merong dapat na mga distribution utilities, lalo na doon sa Visayas,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: na mas mataas ang kanilang naibayad na line rental pero maliit ang balik sa kanila, nagsaganon ay maibalik sa kanila yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. I have no more questions.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang system loss na ma-recover ng distribution utilities sa pamamagitan ng pagpataw ng kanilang system loss charge, ito ay malalaman lamang after the fact na after na makapag-bill na yung generator sa distribution utilities.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So, atin na itong ni-raise as an issue sa BIR and hopefully ma-address ito ng BIR kasi ayaw naman din po natin na magkakaroon po ng sitwasyon na mapagbabayad muna yung...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At tapos ay ma-re-refund o i-cocollectahin nila mula sa BIR.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang nakikita po nating maaaring implementasyon nito ay kung ang mga distribution utilities,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: i-collect lang sila ng VAT corresponding doon sa kanilang energy purchases, katumbas doon sa makocollecta nila at yun ang i-re-remit nila.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At to follow, kung ano yung magiging corresponding na system loss,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: na amount na hindi naman makakasama na at i-reconcile na lang after that month.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So, ito po ay mga implementation issues and tayo naman po ay nakikipag-usap sa BIR.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Nang sa ganon, ay maisagawa na itong pagtatanggal ng VAT sa lalong madaling panahon.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Hopefully, after September, kung October, meron na po yan. At the earliest is November po ang implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, dyan nyo po makikita na action man po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, ito po ang ERC ngayon. That's why I'm very supportive doon sa dagdag nyong budget na 200 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Ano, ang laki po ng binabantayan po nila, ang daming ginagawa, may systems loss pa, very highly technical.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, we need to support ERC. So, November, inaasahan po namin yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Dahil 19th Congress pa, pinaglalaban na po yan ni Congressman Dagooc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Ngayon po, mangyayari na Congressman Dagooc yung ipinaglalaban natin noon pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, next, to interpelate, ang pinakamagaling pong Congressman sa Camarineson, Congressman Nelson Negacion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Salamat po, Mr. Chairman. Magandang umaga po sa DOE family, headed by Secretary Sharon Garin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: I will be talking about electric cooperatives, especially...

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: It is a matter of record and almost public knowledge na yung prangkesa ng mga electric cooperatives ay mag-e-expire na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Pero, syempre, exempted doon yung Casureco 4.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Kasi yung Casureco 4, magaling po yung Congressman doon sa 4th District.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: As early as last Congress, nakapagpa-approve na po siya ng prangkesa for another 25 years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Kaya, mas magaling po talaga yun, si Congressman Arne Puentebella.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: My question can be answered by the Secretary herself, or if you want po, pwede niyo pong ipasa sa ating NEA Administrator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Would you agree with me that...

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Would you agree with me that the grant of franchise by Congress is indispensable?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if Admin Nani can answer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: or distribution utilities cannot do business it cannot operate it cannot distribute power

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: yes i agree uh mr chair

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: however there are extreme conditions or extreme situations that

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: uh electric cooperatives will not deserve i mean do not deserve any franchise renewal but on extreme

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: cases but on functioning on functioning electric cooperatives i believe uh it is very uh important

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: uh that uh congress supports the renewal of franchisor uh

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Ah, pupunta po ako diyan mamaya, 'yon sa tinutukoy ninyong functioning electric cooperatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Pero kaya po naitanong ko po ito kasi po may nagsasabi na hindi ganoon kahalaga yung pagpapa-approve ng prangkesa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Pero ngayon malinaw na kailangan po siya. Okay. Opo.

segments.text: okay now allow me mr chair to proceed to certain policy questions that

segments.text: mr chair i think the power bureau of the doe

segments.text: there's a question um mr chair honorable member an obligation we have the electric power industry

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: To my last three concluding questions, Casoreco III, I am sure the NEA administrator is well aware,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: was an ailing cooperative since within the period 2013 to 2016.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: That is the reason why NEA intervened by establishing or by creating Task Force Rinconada.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Now, since then, Casoreco III has improved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: In fact, from 2021 and for five consecutive years up to the year 2025,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Casoreco III had received the highest rating, which is AAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: For the last five consecutive years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: And that is because of NEA intervention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: That is why we are thankful to NEA, to Task Force Rinconada, because of your intervention from the lowest category.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: So, your debt was very high.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: And every month, it is paying.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: From the 1.2 billion debt since 2013, it is only 120.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I think, even if they have a debt of 1.2 billion, it is only 100 million now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: They added three substations to address the brownout in the problem of the place.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Would you consider it fair to allow the entry of a new, unproven, and untested private distribution company

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: with a mere $5 million paid-up capital into the existing franchise area of a AAA electric cooperative

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: performing well under the NEA standards?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may qualify.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: NEA will always defer to the wisdom of Congress whether or not to grant a new franchise

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: level of responsibility of the feels of this organization.

NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Definitely, what Casoreco III needs is an infusion of fresh capital to improve the reliability.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: It is true that the operation of Casoreco III is not that exciting because it comes from poverty.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: They do not have a sustainable capex to fund.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: That is why we are doing our best and we are looking for a solution on how to cope with such a situation.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Now, the question is, why is the debt so high?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Based on our categorization rules, if a cooperative is in debt and it is being restructured and its restructured arrangement is being paid,

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: we consider it as if it has no debt because it is being paid.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: The same thing is the case of Casoreco III.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, with the indulgence of Cong. Nelson Legacion, I was just confused.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, there was a debt of 1.2 billion in 2017.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, in the span of 6 years, 9 years, it became only 100 million.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: 120 million. So, the improvement is really big.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Well, aside from paying the debt, they are maintaining the...

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: 10 plus operations, it is a big deal because we cannot give them a very good service if they come from poverty.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, so, it means that they have really improved.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: That is why they have been AAA for the last 5 years.

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And if, this is theoretical only, if you are the chairman of the franchise committee, will you grant that electric cooperative, theoretical, if that is the case, to perform, will you grant the franchise?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Because what effect will it have if you do not grant the franchise after 2029?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: It will be a pity for the member consumers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Will it have an effect if it will not operate? Will there be no electricity?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: Well, there is always the risk of a breakdown of the...

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, you are saying if the franchise is not granted, after 2029, no one will operate, there will be no electricity there?

segments.speaker: NEA Administrator Antonio Mariano C. Almeda
segments.text: That is what will happen there.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: Thank you for telling us that you are not giving up on Casa Reko 3.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: And in fact, if you will have to decide, you will give this to the franchise.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And if you decide to run for Congress, I will vote for you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We'll make you the franchise committee chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: It is not a joke, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Sa amin kasi, like electric cooperatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: in the indulgence of my colleagues,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I'm very much supportive sa mga electric co-op

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Our area is rural pa po kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, kailangan pa po namin ng tulong ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And actually, it's beyond our district.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But due diligence and proper courtesy

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: noong lumapit po sa amin ng Casareco 3,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Pero kung twice or thrice na kayong hindi pinapansin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I think we need to intervene

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: hindi po dahil sa politika o ano man,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: na nagbibigay pong servisyo ng kuryente

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: That's why we are very passionate

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: lalo na pagdating sa electric cooperative.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nelson S. Legacion
segments.text: pero ano man na pag-usapan po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Before I call on to the next interpeler,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: pag may mga bago bang nag-apply

segments.text: Tanong ko, is it time ng generation, the gencos, should be regulated na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Although we know in EPIRA, hindi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pero, it's high time, is it?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I do not think that we need to regulate.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But we need to have safeguards, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: For example, once you have a COC, you have the permit, you have the permit forever.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And that's why we are issuing new policies now to have more accountability for the gencos.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Kasi minsan, nakalista yan sa profile natin, sa energy mix natin.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Pero, mga four months a year lang pala siya nandun.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And there has to be accountability.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Dapat siya nagahanap ng replacement power.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, there are things that have been missing over the years.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We need to be more strict in a sense that they have to comply with whatever is required by EPIRA,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: whatever is required by ERC, and the PSA or the contract they entered.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, papunta na kami dyan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And I think if we do regulate, we might dislodge the investment appetite in that sense.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Pero, kailangan talaga medyo may mga regulator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Of course, when Congressman Jokno asked about this solar para sa bayan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: noong 18th Congress, di pa kami congressman ni Kogdagi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kami ang nagra-rally na huwag pagbigyan yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Look what happened to Occidental Mindoro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, when you said, you know, balitan-balitan, 24 billion nilang ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I think hindi yun ang problem.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ang problema dun, did they deliver what is stated in their service contract na magdi-deliver siya ng supply?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: You're correct, Mr. Chair, in a sense that because of, how many megawatts yun?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And had those, it's about 1.3 gigawatts.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: according to our simulation, there would have been a decrease in the price, about 2 pesos ba?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: 1 peso at the very least on the generation rate natin, sir.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, that's, it's not the penalty itself, but it's the cost to our consumers na nangyari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: See, that's the problem, Chairman, because you gave the service contract.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, walang pwedeng umago dun until such time na mag-deliver sila ng ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: In the foreseeable future, magkakaroon kayo ng cancellation of service contracts na hindi pa na-umpisan?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, all the contracts we are being reviewed, we're cleaning it up.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We have cancelled so far about 100 plus, 200 contracts already.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: That's for the service contracts on renewable energy.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Yung hindi gumagalaw, yung wall, late na siya, or wala siyang, ano tawag dito?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, we're cancelling, starting to cancel that.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And then, on the, and then next is we issue the GENCO accountability na kailangan may warning naman.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Pag hindi ka mag-comply ng requirements ng DOE or ERC, strike 1 ka.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Next strike, up to strike 3 ka, we can cancel the COE or blacklist you.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, we are trying to have more discipline.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: In the generation companies, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, maybe in the second round.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan

segments.text: And we will check on the status po of these plants.

ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan

segments.text: That's why we are seeing the yellow...

segments.text: dahil doon natin nakikita nagkakaroon ng spike sa line rental,

segments.text: and then just collect the necessary amounts from the customers

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: But as a long-term solution, there is something to be done doon sa data

segments.text: that will be inputted in the CRSS so that the correct allocation of NSS surplus

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan

segments.text: of the payments or the NSS allocations made over the period from 2021

segments.text: or higher allocation of the NSS.

segments.text: I'll just come back with you.

segments.text: So hindi na kami humahawak ng pera.

segments.text: So I think it's under DOE pa rin yung pera.

segments.text: I'll have Yusek Mario answer this, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: Thank you very much also to our beloved congressman.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: Based on the audit and monitoring records of our auditing unit,

segments.text: we have remitted for Northern Luzon

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: total, with electrification at 762 million, development fund at 524 million, and watershed

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: For the national capital region, we have 8 million total benefits, with electrification

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: at 4.5 million, 2 million for DLF, and for water management at almost 2 million.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: So we have the record here based only on audits.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can you submit that to this committee, please?

segments.text: Tama yan kasi importante ito eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Dapat talaga nakikinabang dito yung rural areas.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Mario Marasigan
segments.text: Yes, our new guidelines on the benefits for host communities includes urban cities. So, it's not only NCR but also those that are urbanized cities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And then to, of course, sa TransCo, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus

segments.text: Marami po, siyempre, mas gusto mas mataas ang compensation.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: And then, of course, the process in court.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: However, we have a program now that we will begin.

segments.text: I-outsource po namin nationwide yung ROW settlement.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: We have a target to clean out all of these claims

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: by 2034 before the concession agreement with the NGCP ends.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: So, we begin with a 50,000-claim target in two years po

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: with this nationwide outsourcing of ROW settlement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, it came to my attention also, right?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: yung iba, yung dinaanan ng linya, actually hindi naman daw siya nagke-claim.
