segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: Yes, we've received some complaints, but we're already handling that.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: Kaya nga po nagkaroon po ng reporma with our processes.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: We will now do only court processes.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: Wala na po 'yung negotiated or out-of-court so that we can avoid these possible abuses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, the 160,000 claimants, so in the next two years, it will go down?

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: We plan to reduce it easily by 50,000 with this outsourcing program po.

segments.speaker: National Transmission Corporation President and CEO Atty. Joseph Omar A. Castillo
segments.text: So, hire a lot of lawyers, real estate brokers nationwide so that we can validate and settle these claims and, of course, file the necessary court cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Those 160,000 claimants, how much in totality when it comes to pesos?

segments.text: Yun pong nga 'yan, there's a new program din po. We will not pay for unregistered land kasi public land na po 'yun.

segments.text: So, there's a total of 220 billion po yung cost na 'yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Mr. Chair, meron po tayong Green Energy Option, GOP. Meron din po tayong ARCOA, Retail Competition and Open Access.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Yung po sa Retail Competition and Open Access, last June 26 po, ibinaba po ng ERC to 100 kilowatts ang threshold.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Yung naman pong Green Energy Option, binaba po ng DOE to 50 kilowatts.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Ngayon po, pag nasa isang prangkisa lang lahat ng mga under sa Department of Agriculture,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: nilang mag-avail noong tinatawag na Retail Aggregation Program.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Pag pinagsama-sama mo sila, aabot na po sila doon sa threshold nitong Retail Competition and Open Access sa CAGIO.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Pwede na po silang pumili kung sino po yung magiging supplier nila na renewable energy.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: And as nasabi ko po kanina, mas mura po ang renewable kesa sa coal, for example.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: So, pwede po mapababa ang presyo ng kuryente nila.

segments.text: Para doon sa pangangailangan ng captive customer niya, at dahil nga mayroon siyang mga customer na nagsipag tayo ng kanilang self-generation facility at mayroon pang benta, mayroon pang export,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: baka mga hulugan nito na magkakaroon siya ng mga kontratang pinasok na hindi naman niya magamit dahil kailangan unahin yung export ng net metering customer.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So, kakailangan din talaga tingnan yung implementasyon, yung current implementation ng net metering.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung hindi na yun makaka-apekto doon naman sa mga kontratang pinasok ng distribution utility para sa pagsisilbi sa kanyang captive customers.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At ang isang pamamaraan dito ay kung ibubuksan yung net metering, hindi lang doon sa distribution utility, kumbaga, hindi lang yung distribution utility ang mamanduhan na bumili o kumuha noong kuryenting yun,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: kundi maaaring iba ring end user o retail electricity supplier ang kukuha o mag-a-aggregate nitong export na ito at ibibenta naman niya sa kanyang customer,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: be it the captive customer or be it the contestable customer or for its own use.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So, tagal po nyo sa pagsisilbi. Bata pa po kayo, nakilala ko na po kayo, Chairman Juan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Meron po kayong sulat, System Loss Performance of Distribution Utilities, dated August 26, 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So, pinag-aaralan ko po ito at tinitinan ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kanina pa po pinag-uusapan, technical loss, dalawa yan, kasi hindi po maintindihan ng masang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ano ba talaga? Kasi napakaraming charges na nakalagay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Buhat nung iyan, bundle natin yung rate. Yun po ang malaking problema eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kaya minumura po lahat ng DEU at saka ng kooperatiba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So, hindi umalaman ng tao kung saan, kung bakit ganito kalaki.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ang generation cost po ba ay merong system.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yun pong malalaki, yung generating corporation, naka-embed na po dyan yung cost ng transmission loss

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: na nai-incur sa pagsusupply mula sa generation plants na nakakonekta sa transmission

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: papunta doon sa kanilang distribution utilities.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So, ang bayaran nila, yung presyohan yan, inclusive na doon sa cost ng transmission loss.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: lahat po lumalabas, hindi lang utility, hindi lang Meralco, hindi lang kooperatiba,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: hindi lang yung malalaking privado o kaya kooperatiba, ang may system loss charge.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Opo, nag-i-incur ng transmission na system loss at may cost yan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Mayroon din sa distribution level, may cost yan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At ang recovery, pagdating sa distribution level na system loss,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ito ay naka-reflect doon sa system loss charge.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dati, bago nung nag-unbundling, ito ay nagsisingil na rin.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya lang, ito ay nakapasok naman doon sa power purchase adjustment, yung PPA,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: noong bago tayo nagkaroon ng IPIRA at ng unbundling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kaya nga, hindi mo maaintindihan ang masang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: kailangan po talaga ng efektibong komunikasyon sa madlang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kesa yung napakarami pong charges sa isang bill na natatarantay tao,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: At, Mr. Chair, we'll work with the ERC on the reformatting of the bill

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: hindi na po akong masasalta dahil maliwanag naman po na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: At, alam ko pong capable ang ating sekretary at saka yung ating ERC Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Now, we move to the recognize Sarah Elago

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para po sa ERC, batay sa inyong ulat as of mid-August,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: may nasa 5,380 consumer complaints ng naisampas sa ERC ngayong taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mas malaki po ito kumpara sa 5,329 complaints noong 2025,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nangangalahati pa lang po tayo ngayong 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at tungkol po sa issue o concern na kaugnay sa serbisyo ko ng Meralco.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano na pong status ng mga complaints na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May na-penalize na po ba ang ERC na electric power industry participant?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kung meron, nakabatay po ito sa anong grounds?

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Una po, lilinawin lang namin yung aming kategorya ng consumer complaints.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dalawang klase po kasi ang tinuturing naming complaints.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: One, yung informal na naisasampas sa amin sa pamamagitan ng email, walk-in, letter, o referral.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito pong mga ganitong nature ng complaints,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: bago po siya talaga maging formal na complaint,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pagitan kami between that consumer and the utility.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Nang sa ganon ay kung magkakaroon ng solusyon or dispute resolution,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ay magagawa nila at their level.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So, ang karaniwan po na nakakarating sa amin ganitong sumbong reklamo

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ay may kinalaman doon sa bill.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Meron po na nagkukwestyon doon sa kanilang natanggap.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At mayroon din naman po ng mga instances na lumalapit sumusulat sa amin.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang kadahilanan naman ay mayroong naging inspeksyon ang utility, ang Meralco,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: at sila ay nakitaan daw ng badges ng mayroong problema doon sa metro.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At ngayon ay sinisingil sila ng differential billing na malaki.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So, sumusulat sila sa amin, pinagbibigay alam na ganito yung sitwasyon nila.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pagka ganito pong instances, pinapatawag namin o sinusulatan namin ang utility upang magkomento.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At nakakaroon ng mga conciliation hearings or conferences between the consumer complainant and the utility representative.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung wala pong maging resolusyon doon sa kanila pong reklamo, amin pong ina-advise sila na gawing formal na yung complaint sa pamamagitan ng pagpa-file ng formal complaint.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: This is a verified complaint, kaparehan ng mga complaint na ipina-file sa mga regular courts.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero ginagamitan po namin ito ng summary procedure, nang sa ganun mabilis lang din po.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kapag na ito na po ay na-transform into a formal complaint, ang turing na po namin dito ay isang proceeding na nangangailangan ng pag-exercise ng quasi-judicial jurisdiction or authority ng ERC.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya sa pagdating sa ganitong proceeding, magkakaroon ng pre-trial conference, tapos presentation of evidence through judicial affidavits,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: o pamisan, nakakaroon din ng formal trial.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Doon po sa dami ng 5,000, [unclear]. Sa ngayon po, as of the latest, ang ongoing po na consumer complaint namin sa pagdating sa Meralco ay nasa 3,657 na.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito po yung mga informal or letter complaints.

segments.speaker: ERC Consumer Affairs Service Acting Director Atty. Leila Grace A. San Pedro
segments.text: Ito po yung mga 629 na clause and termination.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yung pong kabuuan of the letter complaints that we received for 2026, 629 na po yung aming naisara.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, nagkaroon na ng maayos na usapan o resolusyon yung complaint na yan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Consumer Affairs Service Acting Director Atty. Leila Grace A. San Pedro

segments.text: Pero yung pong mga hindi na nagkaayos,

segments.text: It's 51, pero combined, insist po, kasi ito siya.

segments.text: Sa mga distribution utilities, lahat na po, ang ongoing lang sa amin ay 51.

segments.text: Sir, can you submit that data to this committee, please?

segments.text: I will look forward to the ERC submission on this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: I'd actually like to ask, sino po yung mga personal natin na in charge dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano ba natin mapapabilis yung disposition ng mga cases?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano po natin mapapabilis yung pagsagot dito sa mga issues, concerns, complaints na nailalapit sa atin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi nababahala po tayo, bagamat meron naman po tayong substantial number na rin ho,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero kung meron pang maibibilis, para matiyak po natin, agaran natin din na nasasagot kung ano man yung mga concerns

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng ating mga consumers pagdating ho dito.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: has added tasks and added work because of all the SONA directives, also the complaints,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: and with the oil crisis also, dumami talaga.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Every year, there are more power plants to regulate, more distributional utilities and electric co-ops to regulate.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Unfortunately, their budget request has been cut and hopefully the Congress can address that.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: They can have more personnel and more capacity in order to be faster in their responses.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: They're not part of the OE, but they are a regulator, but I think it's about time for them to have a...

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Medyo dagdag lang ng consultants and people also to help them with this, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, sige ho, maisumite na lang ng ERC yung kanilang original proposal for the personal services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Given the added tasks, syempre gusto naman natin maayos din ho yung compensation, matiyak ho yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Karapatan, yung interest din ng lahat ho ng ating mga manggagawa at kapwa lingkod bayan sa pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na sa may napakahalagang gawain na tiyakin na wala hong abuso at wala hong kumbagang lumalagpas sa kung ano lang yung dapat

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pagdating sa napakahalaga na utility na niregulate ho ng ERC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang ngayon naman ho, nais kong magtanong may mechanisms po ba yung ERC para ma-ensure yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Implementation ng Meralco refund na matiyak ho natin na kapag may refund ho sila na matitiyak na matanggap ho ng ating mga consumers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: E hindi naman ho ito maipapasa naman pabalik rin sa mga consumers sa mga susunod na panahon.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yes po, depending on the nature ng refund na iniimplementa ng Meralco, kung ito ay may kinalaman doon sa...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pass-through charge niya, ito ay nire-reflect as a separate item.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung ano yung alimbawa ay refund rate nakatumbas para doon sa over-recovery na yan, ito ay nakareflect yung refund rate na yan at yung corresponding amount.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So makikita rin ito yan sa bill natin and every month, ang Meralco and all other distribution units...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Nagsasubmit po sila ng kanilang implementation ng kanilang pass-through charges para nagkakaroon din po ng confirmation.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At malalaman po na natapos na yung refund dahil kailangan po mag-submite ng report ang Meralco sa ERC na yung utos sa kanila na amount na i-refund.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ay natapos na nila, naisoli na nila ng bumbo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Salamat po, Mr. Chair. At yung antabayanan po natin yung submission mula sa ERC tungkol dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman sa DOE, November 2022, naglabas ng Department Circular No. 2022-11-0034 na nagpapahintulot sa ating pamahalaan na pumasok sa kontrata with foreign citizens, foreign-owned corporations para mapababa yung gasto sa renewable energy projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mula po 2022, ilang kontrata nang pinasok ng ating pamahalaan kaugnay ng renewable energy at sino-sino hong mga foreign-owned corporations ang makausap natin dito?

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Magmula po 2022, nagpas pong isang libong mga kontrata po ang pumasok. Yung mga 100% foreign-owned po, less than 100 po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ganihinga na lang po ng representation na ito, yung listahan, kung sino-sino huya. Alam ko marami. Subukas rin kami soft copy para sa Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, nais kong magtanong tungkol sa statements ng ating sekretary tungkol sa Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sinabi ni Sec. Agarin na ang DOE ay nagdadraft ng circular para maglatag ng guidelines sa paglalagay ng generation capacity para sa data centers at technology hubs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kabilang ng Paxilica. Sinabi niyo rin ho na may several options para matugunan ang power requirement nito mula 50 megawatts, 100 hanggang 5,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano na po ang status nito? May draft na po ba? At kailan ho ito maasahan na matapos at mailabas?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, it's a data center guideline for energization.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Paxilica, they've been repeating na hindi daw sila data center.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We're focusing more on data centers because ito talagang heavy.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We can actually send the draft, pero we are adding more provisions for PESA.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So maybe we will finish by the end of the month.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We can send it once it's finished and I can issue it officially already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sinabi ho ng ating sekretary na may several options.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para ma-supply yan ang energy requirement ng mga data centers na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa kaso ho ng halimbawa na nabanggit ko sa Paxilica, kung sakali ho na mapipirmahan ho natin yung framework sa darating na November.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It's more than a framework. It's just a guideline. What are the options they have?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: For example, halimbawa, they've been saying they need 2 gigawatts or 2,000 megawatts.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, instead of getting it from the grid,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: one option is they can produce it themselves.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: They can put up the power plant.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Another is they can ask somebody to put it up for them.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Or if it's a PESA zone, maybe the economic authority can also do the production of energy and do the distribution and transmission as well.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Or they can get a supplier.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Or pwede din na magkontrata siya halimbawa sa isang supplier.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Ibig sabihin niya yung supplier, siya yung naghahanap.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Tapos nagbebenta lang siya ng power sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, it's like GEOP or RES, ARCOA, na siya yung sasabihin niya halimbawa,

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: one of those retailers, I need 1,000 megawatts of green.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, there are several options without risking our consumers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: In relation to Paxilica, the Secretary said that several renewable energy projects are scheduled for construction in Central Luzon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So, what are these projects, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Yes, we can send you the list of those that are committed or indicative projects.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But these are not for Paxilica.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: This is for the normal needs, the energy mix of the facility.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Philippines, without the data center, let's say.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And data center should be treated differently in a sense na dapat hindi niya kinakain yung kailangan ng mga tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil mahirap kong magsabi na kaya nating supplyan at maraming options,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lalong-lalo na sa panahon ngayon na maraming beses na nagde-declare ng yellow at red alert sa iba't ibang bahagi ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya hindi lang nakakabigla, pero nakakabahala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa ganitong mga dambuhalang proyekto, maraming options.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero yung para sa mga consumers natin, para sa karaniwang tao, ay kulang na kulang na kulang pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung mga kinakailangan natin na hindi lang option, pero yung guarantee na meron talaga silang supply ng kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya pagdating sa ganitong mga proyekto, dapat talaga a priority natin yung pangangailangan ng sambayan ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At hindi uunahin yung interest ng dayuhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At bilang panghuli na lang, Mr. Chair, I have a few seconds left.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napag-aralan na ho ba ng DOE, ng ERC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kumusta ho yung assessment natin sa implementation ng IPIRA sa 25 years po ng pagpapatupad nito?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: I'll give it to Yusek Guevara.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: She's written a book about this.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, I'll let her explain her assessment.

segments.text: Yung pong ating IPIRA journey for the last 25 years, nagkaroon po ng framework.

DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Kasi sandamukal na mga policies ang nilabas pa ng DOE, ng ERC, etc.

DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Sa paninaw po namin, yung pangangailangan ng IPIRA at that time, remember in the 90s?

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: But then, nandun naman tayo ngayon sa energy transition.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: So, the next 25 years ng IPIRA, kailangan natin i-address yung energy transition.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: What is fortunate is that it is the policy of the department because of the renewable energy law

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: to make sure that we increase our capacity for RE by 2030 to 35%, 50% by 2040.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: So, on track po tayo dun sa mga plano natin na ma-achieve.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: At nasolve po talaga natin yung mga madami sa problema na ina-attempt ng IPIRA.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ang pinakamalaking problema dyan, Mr. Chair, yung mahal talaga na singil sa kuryente.

segments.text: At sa tingin po namin, very telling na po yung bilang ng complaints pa lang na natatanggap ng ERC pagdating dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Marami pa pong mga concerns pagdating sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung kakayahan mismo ng mga kababayan natin na magbayad ng mahal na singil sa kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya ho, sana ang nasa pipeline ng mga dapat seryosohin ng kongresong ito at dapat suportahan din ng DOE,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung mga proposals na may kinalaman sa pagtatanggal, halimbawa, ng value-added tax sa kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang po sa system loss, pero pagtatanggal ng VAT sa kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kapag naabot na yung, kung may windfall profits,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung target collection, dapat naman ay magkaroon tayo ng aktibo na mga hakbang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para maging hawan naman at may dagdag ho na relief sa ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na nakakaranas na rin ngayon ng sobrang-sobrang paghihirap

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahil sa mahal na singil, hindi lang po sa kuryente, sa pagkain, sa langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Marami hong mga binabalikat na mga buwis ang ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at isang pagtatanggal sa VAT sa mga atiyak na hakbang na maaari hong makatulong sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yun lamang sa ngayon. Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But, Ipira, I think we really have to amend it.

segments.text: So, there's so many things that we need to do

segments.text: Sana by probably another year, we'll be able to finish it, no?

segments.text: So, pagkatapos suno, it's an old COC, no?

segments.text: and then all the facilities will be turned over to the DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ah, with that statement, ah, base ron sa napag-usapan natin,

segments.text: Pupunta tayo sa lugar ko with

segments.text: I'll just check the schedule, sir,

segments.text: I hanap ko lang ng araw kasi alam ko...

segments.text: But we are ready for the signing already. Yes, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ang sa amin lang na sana mabigyan ito ng priority kasi alam nyo,

segments.text: if mangyari ito, thousands of titles will be issued to individuals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, malaking impact on the government side, sa atin, sa Pangulo, sa administration, sa inyo,

segments.text: sa sekretary, sa DOH, sa RAS, DINR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, this is a very good project, big project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, sana bigyan ito ng malaking, ano?

segments.text: Even wala pa yung schedule na signing nyo.

segments.text: Ahead of time, if you want, sir.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But we're ready for that, yes, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Doon tayo sa national concerns, sa ERC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Sir, tama po ba na ang complaint desk sa ERC, sa Mindanao, sa Dabao?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Saka yung mga hearings, kung mayroon man, sa Dabao rin mangyari?

segments.speaker: ERC Consumer Affairs Service Acting Director Atty. Leila Grace A. San Pedro
ERC Consumer Affairs Service Acting Director Atty. Leila Grace A. San Pedro
segments.text: Attorney Leyla from the Consumer Affairs Service, po, and behalf of the chair.

segments.speaker: ERC Consumer Affairs Service Acting Director Atty. Leila Grace A. San Pedro
segments.text: Yung mga sa DUS po, nasa Mindanao, doon din po igaganapin yung hearing.

segments.speaker: ERC Consumer Affairs Service Acting Director Atty. Leila Grace A. San Pedro
segments.text: Similarly po, kung sa Visayas naman yung mga DUS or ACs, doon din po, sir, igaganapin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Pwede ko ba, ang sekretary, mahalapan natin yung paraan para medyo maluwag

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi in our case, ang Dabao, travel by land, sa amin, is around more or less 10 hours.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, yung complaint, sa gastos lang, eh, di na lang siya mag-complain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, wait, wait, for a while.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: I suggest po, kung pwede, gawin natin regional.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kung hindi talaga kaya, I would suggest na saka ganyan di euro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: The handsome and good congressman of Gagayan de Oro will accommodate on that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi nasa centro po ang Gagayan de Oro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Pero, I would prefer na every region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Para may justice naman doon sa mga nag-complain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: For an orderly proceeding, kindly address the question to the chair.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Before we adopted the online proceedings through video teleconferencing,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ganun po talaga ang aming ginagawa.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For any rate application or any petition affecting the consumers,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: we conduct at least one hearing in the locality affected.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ang aming satellite or field offices ay nasa sa Cebu lang at sa Dabao,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: doon po nagkakaroon ang mga hearings.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And we do understand na mahirap talaga para doon sa ibang mga consumers

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ng iba't ibang mga co-ops in Mindanao or in the Visayas

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: na magbibiyahi pa sila sa Mindanao, sa Dabao, or in the case of Visayas, sa Cebu.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero, noong nangyari po yung pandemic at nagkaroon na rin po ng rules,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ngayon po ang default na hearings na namin,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: both doon sa mga proceedings before the commission

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: at kasama na yung mga consumer...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: ito po ay ginagawa na rin namin through video conferencing online.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya kahit po nasa malayong lugar sa Mindanao,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: maaari na po siyang makapag-participate through this...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito na po yung default namin,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: unless magkaroon nga din po ng request na magkaroon ng in-person na hearing.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito po ay sinusulat na namin dito sa 2026 na Rules of Practice and Procedure ng ERC

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: nang sa ganun ay malinaw na po ito para sa lahat.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At hindi na po maging hadlang ang distansya

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: para makapag-participate at makadulog sa atin ang ating mga consumers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Pero, may qualifications sabi mo eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ito meron lang House of Christmas na magkaroon ng face to face.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: natin sa Cagayan de Oro para nasa gitna.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Oo po, Mr. Chair, we will welcome that choice of venue,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung amin namang pag-set ng mga regional hearings tulad ng consultations or kaya ay yung mga conduct ng aming CREST o yung continuing regulatory education seminars, ito po ay ginaganap namin hindi lang naman sa Cebu City at sa Davao City.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kasi paminsan po ay nakakaroon kami sa mga ibang major cities lalo't may mga pasilidad sila para maka-accommodate ng mga magsisipagdalo sa aming mga public hearings or consultation.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At isa na nga doon yung napag-usapan natin recently ni Congressman Nagooc na maaaring magkaroon ng CREST doon sa malapit sa lugar niya sa Surigao or Agusan.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Sa ganon ay magkaroon din ng pagkakakamal.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pagkakataon ang komisyon na makabisita doon sa iba't ibang lugar na mga consumer ay hindi karaniwan nakakaabot sa amin at makita din namin yung sitwasyon nila doon sa mga lugar nila po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang reason bakit gusto ko sa regional or magiging sa kagandi-oro na lang sa centro para ma-encourage natin yung mga complainant na idulog talaga kung ano yung problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi pag malayo talaga, Mr. Chair, nawawala yung logic natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Nawawala yung purpose ng bakit tayo nagkaroon ng ganyang guidance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, I don't hope na it would be a commitment from you na kung hindi kaya regional, gawin natin sa kagandi-oro.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Opo, whenever we will have to conduct in-person hearings in the Mindanao area, we will of course prioritize having it in...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Of course, our budget for transportation permitting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi we are serving the people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: I-material yung pera dyan pag sinabi natin magsiservisyo sa tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi kung ganyan yung utak natin, hindi tayo nakakaservisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Lahat nalang sasabihin nyo, wala kaming pera, wala kaming pera.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: How we will be able to fund.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yung pong pagkakaroon ng hearing, napapabiyayihin natin yung ating staff from Mindanao, from Davao to kagandi-oro.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At doon magkaroon ng hearing at pabalik.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Dahil po, hindi ito nakasama doon sa aming programa.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Sa aming budget na pinanukala na 1.7%.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At sa aming budget na pinanukala na 1.7 billion, na naging 944 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Sorry, Madam, Mr. Chair, Madam Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Parang invasive man yung datingin ng ating ERC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Nawawala na talaga yung servisyo natin dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi magiging dahilan yung ano natin, budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ayun ang purpose na nandito tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kung hindi ka, kaya mong tulungan sa bayan ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kung makakaya po namin bubiyahe, bubiyahe naman po talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Kaya po, sir. Ang gusto ko. Firm.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Dr. Tanda Tila Bancoro, please wind up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Now, from the minority, Representative Reneco, you are now recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And good afternoon to the Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May several questions lang po tayo in relation sa, well, una po sa income tax holiday for renewable energy developers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This is provided under RA 9513, kung saan the renewable energy sector can avail of tax incentives under the Renewable Energy Act

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: through the securing of a certificate of endorsement by the DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And ang pansin natin, kung titignan po talaga yung listahan, marami po siyang tax incentives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This is for developers and manufacturers, fabricators and suppliers sa ilalim ng Renewable Energy Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: whether that's for the first seven years, income tax holiday, 10 years of duty-free importation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: net operating loss carryover, NOLCO for seven taxable years, etc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero ang napapansin din naman po natin ay with every...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: approved and processing renewable energy project,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ay may mga magsasakat indigenous communities na naapektuhan sa pagtatayo nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, kung amyandahan po ang batas at higpitan yung guidelines sa pag-issue ng certificate of endorsement para sa tax incentives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: para po makonsidera ang epekto ng displacement ng indigenous communities at iba pang mga residente

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: susuportahan po ba ito ng DOE?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung tax incentives na ito or kung ano man po yung benepisyo mapupuntahan nito ay maramdaman makita ng mga magsasaka at indigenous communities.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Mr. Chair, may we say the answer?

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Ang proseso po ng pagkuha ng service contract, marami pong requirements.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Isa sa requirement po niyan ay...

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: At saka po dapat meron pong memorandum of agreement at saka CN na i-produce or CP na ibigay ang NCIP doon sa developer.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Hihingi pa lang po siya ng service contract sa Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: So, yung pong panukala na sinasuggest po ninyo, mukhang embedded na po talaga doon sa batas.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Kasi hindi siya makakakuha ng service contract.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Hanggat hindi niya na-fulfill po yung mga sinabi po ninyo.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Tapos, pagka nakakuha na siyang service contract, saka pa lang po...

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: siya mag-uumpisa ng pre-development, tapos saka po yung magko-construct, tapos saka po magpo-produce.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Saka lang po siya pwede mag-benefit dun sa mga incentives under the Renewable Energy Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Siyempre po, naiintindihan natin na may mga guidelines yung pagkuhan ng FPIC

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and generally meron niyang range kung paano hinahandle ng mga developers, etc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero ang punot-dulo din naman po, gusto natin mapagsilbihan systematically and through a framework level

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

Ilan po ba ang reserve natin for, sa ngayon, yung capacity ng reserve natin for diesel. At least for diesel lang.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We actually created, formulated a fuel transition plan. Because, you're correct, we cannot be dependent on imported fuel. We are 100% dependent on that. Well, 99%. So, our plan is by 2040, bawasan natin ang 50% yan. And how do we get there? We have several plans. There are several components, electric vehicles, more exploration, electrification of our appliances.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Lahat-lahat po, we're working on that. And in addition to that, we need reserves in the country. Unfortunately, our storage facilities are private. Ginagamit lang natin yung binibilang natin. When we tell you in the news there's 50 days, it's in the private facilities.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: PNOC, headed by President Chico Alvarez, is setting up, and hopefully within this term, we can set up 1 billion barrels.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: The storage facility na government-owned. Para over time, we increase and increase. It is true that we are protected if we have reserves. Kasi I think it was Yusek Sandy who told me that having reserves not only protects you from the unpredictability or volatility of whatever war there is in the rest of the world, it also shields us, it affects our growth.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Kasi nasi-shield tayo sa currency exchange, sa volatility of the price. So malaki talaga yung advantage sa atin pag meron tayo. So we're working on it already.

segments.text: Yes, I do understand. Pero sa ngayon po, ilan yung capacity natin, whether public or private storage?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Thank you for the comment, Mr. President. Andami nating inuutos kasi sa NIA, sa ERC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: sa DOE. Pero parang kulab tayo. Baka matapyasan yung mga plan-plan-plan control na yan. Kasi

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: lahat tayo apiktado dito sa agency na to. So doon sa kanina nakagip na issue ko, Mr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I appeal to the Secretary to seriously consider the amendment of the CSP. Yung sabi ko kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: to avoid yung mataas na nodal price, baka magkaroon ng right of first refusal. Yung ano, nandoon

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Nag-re-propose pa lang? Tapos na, ma'am?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: No, he's been telling me that for four years already.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Yung ano, yung pinakamalapit preference to pinakamalapit na planta sa CSP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi doon mayuwasan natin yung mga nodal na mataas. May I ask, Chair Neno, di ba ancillary, regulated natin yung ancillary?

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: For the ASPAS, yes, Mr. Chair. The contract. But for the reserve market, the one that we approved was the...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: The price determination methodology based on the WESM rules.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ito kasi ang issue ko diyan, ngayon lang nag-MLD kami sa Mindanao. Kaya nag-plucked with yung si Argao tatlong bisis. Yung mga Amerikano doon, nag-re-reklamo na naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung pala, nag-MLD na si Aniko, Tinmiga, ganon-ganon. So, can we account? Can we require NGCP? Ano-ano ba yung mga planta na under sa ASPA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Gusto ko malaman kung talagang may nagawa yung binabayaran natin na ancillary. Kasi in layman's understanding, ay back-up yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kung may generator ako sa bahay, nagbayad ako ng operator kahit naka-standby lang. Tapos nawala yung ano ko sa distribution utility ko. Hindi pala maka-under yung generator ko. E di wala silbi. Nagbayad tayo ng ancillary. Pero nag-manual or dropping pa rin tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Saan yung binabayaran natin na back-up kung magkaroon tayo ng interruption? So, gusto nating i-account yan, Mr. Chair. Napakahalaga po yung usaping ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: We need to require the system operator to account. Sino solo yung mga planta na naka-ASPA? Tapos saan yung location? Saan ginagamit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: In a situation na nagkaroon ng mga post-outages yung mga beast load natin, nagamit ba talaga yung mga planta na yun? Otherwise, nagbabayad tayo ng isang planta tatlong beses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Baka yung isang planta na yan, Mr. Chair, 100 mega. Ang bilateral lang 80. Bininta nila ngayon sa ASPA yung 10. Tapos yung 10 bininta sa reserve market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Baka yung isang planta, ginamit na beast load, ginamit na ancillary. So, medyo kailangan nating i-account yan. Although, additional na trabaho ito ng ERC. Pero, NGCP is a regulated entity. Yung nangulikta niyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tingnan natin, mayroon ba talagang nagamit na ancillary every time na sinisingil tayo ng ancillary services charge?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi 22% na ngayon yung patong from the previous billing period. Lumubo na ng 30% plus ngayon sa August na billing period. But still, may yellow, may red alert, may manual load dropping pa rin tayo. Sana gamit yung binayaran natin na backup na ancillary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Then, finally, doon sa sityo electrification, ako po yung nababahala. Bilang isang dating lineman, alam ko po kung ano yung standard na systems laws sa isang rural area served by an electric cooperative. Based on the standard ng US, na doon natin kinupya tong rural electrification program ng Pilipinas, 12% po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: If the NIA will agree, baka po pwedeng para lang nasa special provision sakaan natin, na anytime the NIA will decide to do this, the NIA can drop a special provision.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Now, kung saka-sakali, after evaluation ng NIA, mas favorable pa economically and technically.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Now, instead of extending the line, ay lagyan na lang natin ng solar doon, panel, lagyan natin ng battery storage na equivalent doon sa requirement nung sitio na yan, o yung bayan na yan, atuturuan natin, itrain natin na mag-operate sila, without extending the line, nagkaroon din tayo ng sitio electrification program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: That is a very practical solution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung area ninyo, area namin, Eastern Samar, ay doon po dumadaan ang bagyo, pero nakita ko po sa NIP, 200 million pa rin yung iserp, 200 million pa rin yung iserp.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, I think NIA should, again, request the speaker, the leadership, na dagdagan yan, kasi pag nag-transforce, libre na nga yung mga line money, pero yung pagkain na Manila doon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, napakaliit po yung 200 million, dalawang bagyo lang yun, tapos na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, if the NIA will agree on my proposal, pwede nasing maglagyan doon in the proper time yung special provision na the NIA may opt to use new technology instead of extending the line in the case of sitio electrification.

segments.text: Ma'am, last term na po ni Congressman Dagoog.

segments.text: So, kung kailangan nyo sa NIA, kahit saan, energy family, mapapakinabangan nyo po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: No, we will miss them, boss.

segments.text: Ayun, ah, meron pa, mamaya na lang.

segments.text: for a status report on yung

segments.text: at the height of the energy crisis.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, when we purchased diesel na ginagamit ng Napocor ang diesel sa mga isla niya, they were affected. They would be directly affected. Iaakit yung presyo doon ng electricity.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, as a directive, I gave PNOC the authority to sell it to Napocor for generation of electricity at a preferential rate para hindi naman mag-suffer yung mga taga-isla natin.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And that worked with them for a while. I think about, siguro kung mga 80 yung presyo, 60 pesos ba yung binigay.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: At a loss naman na binigay.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Binenta ng PNOC. But I think that's a sacrifice that we were willing to do para hindi naman mag-suffer yung mga consumers ng isla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, actually, itong magkatabi pala yung nag-deal. PNOC to Napocor, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: PNOC is easy. Hindi pala, siko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. President Nograles, ibig ba sabihin nito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nakamura sa kuryente yung pagbili ng diesel from PNOC easy?

segments.speaker: NAPOCOR President and CEO Jericho Jonas B. Nograles
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair, for the question. Opo, nakamura po sa kuryente dahil yung pagbili po ng Napocor sa PNOC easy ay mas mura po sa mga current suppliers ng Napocor.

segments.speaker: NAPOCOR President and CEO Jericho Jonas B. Nograles
segments.text: Ang impact po niyan ay hindi po malaki yung strain sa UCME na napupunta.

Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And how much was purchased by Napocor?

segments.speaker: NAPOCOR President and CEO Jericho Jonas B. Nograles
segments.text: Umiiba po yung presyo dahil dynamic po yung pricing.

segments.speaker: NAPOCOR President and CEO Jericho Jonas B. Nograles
segments.text: Opo, umiiba po yung presyo but all in all yung na-drawdown po namin sa PNOC easy is 27 million liters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, yan yung para sa mga diesel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano na po ba yung mga?

segments.speaker: NAPOCOR President and CEO Jericho Jonas B. Nograles
segments.text: Nag-serve po yan doon sa aming mga diesel power plants sa mga isla, sa missionary electrification areas. So, doon po sa mga areas na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung mga barges? Is that it?

segments.speaker: NAPOCOR President and CEO Jericho Jonas B. Nograles
segments.text: Mostly mga small generators po. Sub 500 kilowatts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Sige. Anyway, I asked for a report on that. Thank you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang sunod na mga tanong ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Actually, this has to do with the Luzon Economic Corridor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And makita namin sa website ng U.S. Embassy, meron silang mga announcements about energy-related projects na actually parang mas narinig pa natin ito sa U.S. Embassy kaysa sa Philippine government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kaya gusto natin marinig yung direkta sa gobyerno natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: That yung mga involvement daw ng U.S. in one, nuclear, two, in yung mga fuel pipeline, hydro, and so on and so forth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, with regard to nuclear energy, binanggit po dito yung 1-2-3 agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At saka may mga pinupondohan ng U.S. like an SMR feasibility study, a nuclear reactor control room study.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Simulator, study tour for Philippine legislators on nuclear, and so on and so forth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Alam ko po si Sec. Garin, when she was still U.S. Sec., was closely involved with the 1-2-3 agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, pwede po bang makapagbigay kayo ng updates and ano ba talaga ang status ng mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: nuclear energy sa plano ng Pilipinas?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Actually, the activity, the nuclear-related activities mentioned here, that's not necessarily just because of the Luzon Economic Corridor.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We've been doing this for a long time already.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Some of the studies, like feasibility study, are done with private entities.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: They talk directly to the types of Miralco, or I don't know if they talk to Aboitis and all the other companies.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Sila kasi interested din sa nuclear.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But some of these activities, yes, we do the simulator.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We're trying to lock that in.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Also, the trade mission, we do that every year.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Not only with the U.S., but all the other countries.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, tama naman yung marami dito, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Now, what is the status of nuclear?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Nuclear is, currently, we already have a roadmap.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But, unfortunately, our original roadmap was based on SMR, which could have entailed shorter construction.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Pero ngayon, parang it seems like limited yung options on SMR.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And maybe we'll go for conventional.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But that's something that we have to study further.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But our target is still steady.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It will take time, depending on where it will be.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We are complying with the international requirements on safety, security, and safeguards.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: At that, training ng tao, supply chain assess, evaluation, legal, international cooperation.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Everything else, we're trying to complete.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And, in fact, we have been reviewed by IAEA na pumasa na kami sa...

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Pag pumasa tayo sa next level, pwede na tayo mag-construct.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: What's lacking now is the regulatory on the safety, which is the fill atom na pinasa natin last year.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It has to be organized and the IRR has to be issued.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, once that's there, I think the interested parties can already apply na sa fill atom.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And sa amin kasi, it's more on energy lang.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: The technology has to go through rigorous evaluation through fill atom.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang nasa plano ng DOE initially is SMR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero ngayon sinasabi nyo, baka hindi na SMR conventional.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: It depends on the appetite of the investor.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Let's just say, I'll give you a ballpark of how much it will cost.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And I don't think government, even in a regular power plant, di naman tayo yung nag-invest.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, we will rely solely on the decision of the private.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kino-consider nyo rin ba yung China as a provider?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We actually invited China for our next forum.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, we can talk to them what's to offer.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: We're just exploring so we would know what are the technologies available and how much it will cost.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: So, Korea, China, Japan, Canada, US.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: France, those are the main players right now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dito po sa, again, US Embassy site, meron daw Energy Secure Philippines program with 24 million dollars funding,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: which includes upgrading power systems at military installations, deploying backup power solutions,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: and investing in microgrids and energy storage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kanina sa Visayas, nag-deploy kayo ng energy storage.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: These are, if I understand correctly, Mr. Chair, these are mostly technical assistance.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Mga, they study, we ask them to study something and then, yes, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Ang simulator ng US kasama dyan.

segments.text: Itong Energy Secure Philippines program, are you involved in this as well?

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Maybe Yusef Kebara can explain for you.

DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: It used to be a USAID, but now it's under the US Department of State.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: They have hired consultants for this program.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Tapos po yung project na yan, hindi lang po DOE ang kasama magde-benefit,

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: pati po yung other government agencies like DENR at saka DOST.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: So, yung pong nakalista dyan, kunyari yung simulator, mahal po yun.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Rowena Cristina L. Guevara
segments.text: Malaki po dun sa 24 million dollars ang magagastos doon.

segments.text: Tapos yung pong sinasabi niya na for emergency, yun po yung aming emergency system na pinapadala sa mga areas pagkatapos ng bagyo
